title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Threads
topics: Relief grooves for grinding zones (UNI4386 comparison)
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must comply with UNI4386 standard with TRASMITAL specifications
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Thread relief grooves must be made where threaded zone ends at shoulder with ledge function
Thread relief groove dimensions determined by pitch P: <1.25mm, 1.5-1.75-2mm, 2.5-3mm
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: Grinding relief 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, angle 30°, radius R 0.1
Grinding relief 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6mm, angle 30°, radius R 1...1.6
Grinding relief 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 1.2mm, angle 30°, radius R 2.5
Grinding relief >125mm: width 7mm, depth 5...11mm, angle 30°, radius R4.0
tolerances: Grinding relief >125mm: width ±0.2mm (with geometric tolerance B), depth +0.3/-0mm
Thread relief groove angle: 3.2° on both sides
inspection: Verify groove dimensions against UNI4386 standard
Check TRASMITAL-specific deviations from UNI regulation
Verify thread relief groove presence at shoulder intersections
Confirm groove dimensions match thread pitch specification
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding wheel run-out in grinding operations
Thread relief grooves are mandatory only when thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Grinding relief groove depth varies significantly with diameter (0.4mm to 11mm)
30° angle is standard for grinding relief grooves across all diameter ranges
Special grooves beyond standard specifications must be detailed in drawing
training_guidance: NX agent must recognize bearing seat and seal seat transitions requiring grinding relief grooves
When modeling shafts, automatically check diameter range and apply corresponding UNI4386 groove geometry
For threaded features ending at shoulders, agent must evaluate if ledge function exists and insert thread relief groove accordingly
Thread pitch parameter must drive relief groove dimensions per table (R, A, B, T1, T2)
Agent should flag any custom relief groove requirements for manual review and detailing
Grinding relief grooves use asymmetric tolerances (typically positive on depth, balanced on width)
Model thread relief with 3.2° draft angle and appropriate radius based on pitch
Validate that groove width and depth fall within tolerance bands for the diameter range
summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones per UNI4386 with TRASMITAL modifications, specifying four diameter-dependent groove geometries (18-50mm through >125mm) with precise widths, depths, 30° angles and radii; and TAB-002 for thread run-out grooves required at shoulders, with dimensions driven by thread pitch across three ranges. Both standards include detailed dimensional tolerances and require explicit callout of any non-standard variations on drawings.
